Affinity: Affinity for a type of thing (such as artifacts) makes this spell cost {1} less for each of those things you control.
Basic landcycling: Pay the cost and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a basic land card, put it in your hand, then shuffle.
Bushido: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +N/+N until end of turn (N is the number after the word).
Cascade: When you cast this spell, exile cards from the top of your library until you hit a nonland card that costs less, and you may cast that card for free; the rest go on the bottom in a random order.
Channel: Channel lets you pay a cost and discard this card from your hand to get a special effect instead of casting it.
Constellation: Constellation abilities trigger whenever this permanent or another enchantment enters the battlefield under your control.
Convoke: Your creatures can help pay for this spell: each creature you tap while casting it pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.
Cycling: Pay the cycling cost and discard this card from your hand to draw a new card.
Deathtouch: Any amount of damage this deals to a creature, even 1, is enough to destroy it.
Defender: This creature can't attack, but it can still block.
Double: Some effects double a number, such as a creature's power, the +1/+1 counters on it, or the damage dealt to a player.
Double strike: This creature deals combat damage twice: once before creatures without first strike, and again at the normal time.
Enchant: Found on Auras, it says what the Aura can be attached to (such as a creature or a land); if that thing leaves the battlefield, the Aura goes to the graveyard.
Equip: Pay the equip cost to attach this Equipment to a creature you control, but only on your own turn when you could cast a sorcery.
Exert: You may exert this creature as it attacks to get a bonus, but then it won't untap during your next untap step.
Explore: Reveal the top card of your library: if it's a land, put it in your hand; if not, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and either leave the card on top or put it into your graveyard.
Fight: When two creatures fight, each one deals damage equal to its power to the other.
First strike: This creature deals its combat damage before creatures without first strike, so it can often defeat an opponent before getting hit back.
Flash: You may cast this card any time you could cast an instant, even during your opponent's turn.
Flashback: You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying its flashback cost, and then it is exiled.
Flying: Can only be blocked by creatures with flying or reach.
Food: A Food is an artifact token you can pay {2}, tap, and sacrifice to gain 3 life.
For Mirrodin!: When this Equipment enters, create a 2/2 red Rebel creature token and attach the Equipment to it.
Haste: This creature can attack and use its tap abilities on the same turn it comes under your control.
Heroic: Heroic abilities trigger whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature.
Investigate: Create a Clue, an artifact token you can pay {2} and sacrifice to draw a card.
Kicker: You may pay an extra kicker cost as you cast this spell to get a bigger or additional effect.
Landcycling: Pay the cost and discard this card from your hand to search your library for a land card of the stated kind, put it in your hand, then shuffle.
Landfall: Landfall abilities trigger whenever a land enters the battlefield under your control.
Lifelink: Damage dealt by this creature also makes you gain that much life.
Madness: If you discard this card, you may cast it right away for its madness cost instead of just putting it into your graveyard.
Menace: This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.
Mentor: Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on another attacking creature you choose that has less power than it.
Mill: To mill a number of cards, put that many cards from the top of a library into its owner's graveyard.
Morbid: Morbid abilities get an extra effect if any creature died this turn.
Ninjutsu: Pay the ninjutsu cost and return one of your unblocked attacking creatures to your hand to put this card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Pack tactics: Pack tactics abilities trigger when this creature attacks if the creatures you attacked with have a total power of 6 or more.
Protection: Protection from a quality (such as a color) means this can't be blocked, targeted, enchanted, or equipped by anything with that quality, and damage from those sources is prevented.
Prowess: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Raid: Raid abilities give a bonus if you attacked with a creature earlier this turn.
Reach: This creature can block creatures with flying.
Scry: Look at the top N cards of your library, then put any of them on the bottom and the rest back on top in any order.
Support: Support N puts a +1/+1 counter on each of up to N other target creatures.
Surveil: Look at the top N cards of your library, then put any of them into your graveyard and the rest back on top in any order.
Trample: When this creature attacks and is blocked, any damage beyond what is needed to destroy its blockers can be dealt to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
Treasure: A Treasure is an artifact token you can tap and sacrifice to add one mana of any color.
Typecycling: Like cycling, but instead of drawing you pay the cost and discard this card to search your library for a card of the named type, put it in your hand, then shuffle.
Undergrowth: Undergrowth abilities grow stronger with the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
Vigilance: Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap, so it can still block on your opponent's turn.
Ward: Whenever this becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, that spell or ability is canceled unless they pay the ward cost.
